gh api repos/seathatflowsinourveins/native-agent-stack/actions/runs/<run_id>/jobs?per_page=100 --jq '.jobs[] | select(.name=="validate" or .name=="actionlint-successor") | [<run_id>, .name, .id, .run_attempt, .status, .conclusion, .started_at, .completed_at, ([.steps[] | select(.name|test("actionlint")) | (.name + "=" + (.conclusion//"null"))] | join(";"))] | @tsv'
hosted_parity.what_success_means: Each actionlint step runs under bash -e (the log's `shell: /usr/bin/bash -e {0}`) and ends with `actionlint -color`; a success conclusion means the script exited 0, and actionlint exits 0 only when it found no problem (sources.exit_status). So on each run both binaries reported no diagnostic on that commit's workflows. The table pairs step conclusions; it does not pair diagnostics, and no run exercised a workflow that either binary rejects.
